bios.text: Celia's boyfriend. They're fighting on the bridge because he'd rather chase his dream of going to space.
Thom's girlfriend, who has a robot hand. She's breaking up with him on the bridge.
An older man working with the crew in the church.
Thom, forty years after the breakup on the bridge. The crew is counting on him.
One of the crew in the church.
One of the crew in the church. He's keeping track of how much time they have.
One of the crew in the church, with a mechanical eye.
He's in charge of the crew in the church and calling the shots.
The crew's tech. He's at the screens, syncing the robot's memory.
